title: Set 230

sentences.ko: 동생이 또 돈 좀 빌려 달래. 도와주고 싶긴 한데, 지난번에 빌려 간 것도 아직 안 갚았거든. 근데 안 된다고 했다가 동생한테 무슨 일이라도 생기면 너무 마음이 안 좋을 것 같아. 아, 모르겠다. 너라면 어떻게 할 거야?
sentences.text: My brother asked if he could borrow some money again, and I want to help him, but he still hasn't paid me back from last time. But if I say no and something happens to him, I'm going to feel terrible. Ugh, I don't know. What would you do?

alts.text: Ugh, my brother wants to borrow money again. I wanna help him, but he never paid me back from last time. But if I say no and something happens to him, I'm gonna feel terrible. I dunno. What would you do?

My brother has asked whether he may borrow some money once again, and I would like to help him, but he has not yet repaid me for the last loan. However, if I decline and something happens to him, I will feel terrible. I am not sure what to do. What would you do?

sentences.note: **paid me back** 는 빌린 돈을 갚았다는 뜻이고, **hasn't paid me back** 이라고 하면 아직 안 갚았다는 말이 됩니다. **What would you do?** 는 너라면 어떻게 하겠냐고 조언을 구할 때 쓰는 말입니다.
sentences.situation: 친구한테 고민 상담하면서 결론은 못 내리기

sentences.ko: 그러니까 나는 정오쯤 도착하는데 너는 그날 밤에야 오는 거 맞지? 그럼 나는 그냥 체크인하고 호텔에서 너 기다릴까, 아니면 먼저 혼자 박물관 다녀올까?
sentences.text: Okay, so I land around noon, but you don't get in until that night, right? So should I just check in and wait for you at the hotel, or do you want me to go ahead and do the museum by myself?

alts.text: I get in around noon and you're not there till that night, right? So I just check in and wait at the hotel, or want me to go hit the museum on my own?
I will be arriving at around noon, but you will not arrive until that evening, is that correct? Should I check in and wait for you at the hotel, or would you prefer that I visit the museum on my own?

sentences.note: **land** 는 비행기가 도착한다는 뜻으로 일상에서 많이 씁니다. **go ahead and** 는 상대를 기다리지 않고 먼저 해 버린다는 느낌을 줍니다.

sentences.ko: 배송 조회가 한 5일째 그대로야. 멤피스에 있다고만 나와서 잃어버린 건지 그냥 어디 창고에 처박혀 있는 건지 알 수가 없어. 근데 금요일까지는 꼭 받아야 돼. 여동생 생일 선물이거든.
sentences.text: The tracking hasn't changed in like five days. It just says it's in Memphis, so I can't tell if it's lost or if it's just sitting in a warehouse somewhere. And I really need it by Friday, because it's my sister's birthday present.

alts.text: It's been stuck on the same tracking update for like five days. Just says Memphis, so I can't tell if it's lost or just sitting in some warehouse. And I really need it by Friday, it's my sister's birthday present.

The tracking information has not been updated in approximately five days. It indicates only that the package is in Memphis, so I cannot determine whether it has been lost or is simply being held in a warehouse. I do need it by Friday, as it is a birthday present for my sister.

sentences.note: **sitting in a warehouse** 는 물건이 창고에서 움직이지 않고 그대로 있다는 말입니다. **I can't tell if** 는 ~인지 아닌지 모르겠다고 할 때 씁니다.

sentences.ko: 이번 주말에 차고 정리하려고 했는데, 결국 내내 소파에 누워서 책만 읽었어. 근데 솔직히 하나도 안 찔려. 그렇게 쉬어 본 게 진짜 오랜만이거든.
sentences.text: I was going to clean out the garage this weekend, but I ended up just lying on the couch and reading the whole time. And honestly, I don't even feel bad about it, because I haven't done that in so long.

alts.text: So much for cleaning out the garage this weekend. I just lay on the couch reading the whole time. And honestly? I don't even feel bad, cause I haven't done that in forever.

I had intended to clean out the garage this weekend, but I ended up lying on the couch and reading the entire time. To be honest, I do not feel guilty about it, as I have not done that in a very long time.

sentences.note: **ended up** 은 원래 계획과 달리 결국 ~하게 됐다는 뜻입니다. **I don't even feel bad about it** 은 그것 때문에 전혀 찜찜하지 않다는 말입니다.
sentences.situation: 주말에 아무것도 안 하고 쉰 게 좋았다고 말하기

sentences.ko: 토요일에 룸메이트랑 그 스피닝 수업에 갔거든. 처음엔 괜찮았는데 다음 날 아침에 일어나니까 열이 나고 온몸이 쑤시는 거야. 한 1년 만에 다시 하는 건데 너무 무리했나 봐.
sentences.text: So I went to that spin class with my roommate on Saturday, and I felt fine at first, but I woke up the next morning with a fever and my whole body hurt. I guess I pushed way too hard for my first time back in like a year.

alts.text: Saturday I did that spin class with my roommate, felt fine at first, then woke up the next morning with a fever and my whole body hurting. Guess I way overdid it for my first time back in like a year.

On Saturday I attended that spin class with my roommate. I felt well at first, but I woke up the following morning with a fever and pain throughout my body. I suppose I exerted myself far too much for my first time back in about a year.

sentences.note: **pushed way too hard** 는 몸을 너무 무리하게 썼다는 뜻이고, casual 의 **overdid it** 도 같은 말입니다. **first time back** 은 한동안 쉬었다가 처음 다시 한다는 뜻입니다.

reviewed: 1번 formal 의 repaid me from the last time 은 어색해서 repaid me for the last loan 으로 고침
2번 casual 이 text 의 뒷부분(So should I just check in and wait for you at the hotel)을 그대로 되풀이해서 더 짧고 축약된 구어로 바꿈 (hit the museum 은 들르다는 뜻으로 맞게 씀)
2번 한국어 첫머리 '자, 나는' 이 번역투라 '그러니까 나는' 으로 고침
4번 한국어 '하나도 안 미안해' 는 누구에게 미안한 상황이 아니라 뜻이 어긋나서 '하나도 안 찔려' 로 고침
